_note: Per-(HW x model) overlay for qwen3.6 (Qwen3-Next 35B-A3B NVFP4) on GB10. Overrides the HW profile for this checkpoint; model wins over the HW profile, explicit env wins over both.
_note_thinking_sampling: qwen3.6 is a thinking model. Its generation_config.json ships a generic do_sample temperature of 1.0, but the Qwen3 model card's REASONING preset is temp=0.6, top_p=0.95, top_k=20. The server's thinking floor reused the generic 1.0, which is too hot for a long reasoning chain on a 3B-ACTIVE MoE: the chain drifts and derails mid-thought (measured 2026-09-17: temp 1.0 thinking went off-topic into unrelated content; the answer was also truncated because reasoning ate the token budget). These flags pin the vendor's thinking preset so enable_thinking=true is coherent. Thinking stays default-OFF at the server; this only governs the sampling WHEN a request opts into thinking.

MIMIRMIND_THINKING_TEMP.effect: Thinking-phase temperature 0.6 (Qwen3 reasoning preset), overriding the generic generation_config 1.0 that derailed long reasoning chains on this 3B-active model.

MIMIRMIND_ENABLE_JINJA.effect: Render chat prompts from the model's own chat_template.jinja via minja instead of the hand-transcribed encodeQwen. Validated 2026-10-01: jinja render == vLLM (HF transformers.apply_chat_template) byte-for-byte on all 6 anchor shapes incl the tools block. Fixes encodeQwen's compact-JSON tools-block drift (t.dump() vs the spaced tojson the model was trained on). Server decides; explicit MIMIRMIND_ENABLE_JINJA env still wins.

MIMIRMIND_GDN_PROJ_FUSE_BATCH.effect: Fuse the GDN input/output projections into 2 wide FP8 GEMMs instead of 4 narrow ones (removes per-call quant + cuBLASLt overhead). Measured 2026-10-02 on GB10: gdn.proj 12.8->9.0 ms/step, single-stream decode 16.5->17.5 tok/s (+6%). Coherence goldset (30 prompts, greedy, off vs on): OFF 30/30 == ON 30/30 correct, 0 degradations, only benign wording-drift on 3 free-form prompts (fused per-tensor E4M3 scale, not bit-identical). Server decides; explicit env still wins.
